title: House Price Index & Market Trend Forecasting

blueprintSignals.name: Repeat-sales pairs
blueprintSignals.definition: log price change between two sales of the same property divided by the years between them
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Few pairs exist in thin markets, so pool by region and report the count

blueprintSignals.name: Mortgage rate
blueprintSignals.definition: average new-loan rate lagged by one to three months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use the rate known at the forecast date, not the revised one

blueprintSignals.name: Active listings
blueprintSignals.definition: change in unsold inventory over the last quarter, scaled by monthly sales
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Definitions of active differ by portal, so standardise before comparing

blueprintSignals.name: Search interest
blueprintSignals.definition: portal search volume for an area, indexed to its own 12-month mean
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Search volume is noisy and affected by portal changes, so check for breaks in the series

engineFeatures.meaning: mean of the last 7 and 28 days and their ratio, known at the forecast origin
values on the same weekday in previous weeks
what is already booked or ordered for the target day at the origin
promotion and external-signal flags for the target day, as published at the origin
how many of the recent days are missing in the feed

label: For "House Price Index & Market Trend Forecasting": Produce repeat-sales and hedonic price indices by area and forecast price movement for the next quarters. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: A back-test run only through a rising market flatters any model that predicts continued growth.
